description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a wrapper for the libparodus library, managing connection, message handling, and notifications for a device management system.

methods.name: libpd_set_notifyConfigFile
methods.description: Sets the configuration file for notifications.

methods.name: stop_parodus_recv_wait
methods.description: Signals to stop the parodus receive loop.

methods.name: libpd_client_mgr
methods.description: Manages the lifecycle of the libparodus connection and handles incoming requests.

methods.name: parodus_receive_wait
methods.description: Main loop to receive and process messages from parodus.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification message via libparodus.

methods.name: get_parodus_url
methods.description: Fetches the parodus and client URLs from configuration files.

methods.name: connect_parodus
methods.description: Establishes connection to parodus with exponential backoff retries.
